remarks: Excellent 77 acre mostly wooded, secluded parcel with a 3,400+ sf barn. This is an excellent site to build your future home with a beautiful view and enough acreage to guarantee you won’t have any neighbors build too close to you. The woods hasn’t had any harvest activity in several years and is currently a mixture of red oak, red maple, aspen, white pine, some cherry and some brushy areas that provide excellent habitat for turkey and whitetail deer. The woods has some value now and will continue to improve over the years. There are three pond, an all season stream, and an internal trail system that would be ideal for hunting, hiking, riding horses or ATV’s. This property is loaded with possibilities for you, your family and friends of all ages to relax and enjoy nature.  Located only 11 miles from Ellicottville which opens up even more possibilities from Skiing, Tubing and golfing.  More hunting and hiking are also available at the nearby State Game Land.
